name: Platinum Rewards

rewards.redemption_notes: 5X on gas paid at the pump and EV charging stations; 3X at supermarkets (including most Target and Walmart locations) and restaurants, and on TV, radio, cable, and streaming services; 1.5X on all other purchases. Unlimited points. Points valued at a minimum of $0.0085 each, up to $0.01. Redeem for travel, merchandise, and gift cards. Points expire 5 years from the date earned.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Protect your cell phone against theft and damage for the next calendar month by paying your monthly wireless bill with your PenFed credit card.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Coverage
benefits.description: When you purchase your travel ticket with your PenFed credit card, you are eligible for accident coverage of up to $250,000.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Member Offers
benefits.description: Member-only discounts and special savings on food and wine, shopping, sports, hotels, car rentals, entertainment, and more exclusive to Visa Signature.

benefits.title: Access to Luxury Hotel Collection
benefits.description: Access to premium offers and discounts on luxury hotels around the world.

benefits.title: Complimentary Concierge Service
benefits.description: Visa concierge service available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year for travel, dining, and entertainment needs.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Use your PenFed credit card worldwide without any additional fees.

notes: Visa Signature. $0 annual fee. 5X gas/EV charging, 3X supermarkets/restaurants/streaming, 1.5X all other purchases. No foreign transaction fees.
